claim: Imposing an upper bound on the mutual information between messages and observations, derived from a bandwidth constraint, minimizes the entropy of messages.
falsifier: One can implement a multi-agent communication system with a bandwidth constraint, derive an upper bound on mutual information between messages and observations, and measure the entropy of the resulting messages to verify that it is minimized.

conditions: Bandwidth constraint is modeled as an optimization constraint
Upper bound on mutual information is derived from the bandwidth constraint
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the IMAC method and its reported experimental conditions; transfer beyond those settings is unestablished.

title: Imposing an upper bound for Minimized entropy of messages
